description: Workflow-layer recipes. Replace REPLACE_* plus the published-template, open-conversation, and stable outTrackId placeholders at workflow setup; bind credentials only in n8n. Build source data upstream; this package does not fetch external services.

patterns.title: Workflow failure
patterns.summary: A workflow failed; review the sanitized execution details.
patterns.create: On error, create one alert using a stable execution-derived outTrackId.
patterns.update: If a recovery workflow resolves the incident, update the same card to a success or cancelled status presentation; workflow owns transition policy.
patterns.callback: No callback required. If adding an action, use only a verified request-button/action callback with Stream enabled.
patterns.sensitivity: Do not place credentials, raw stack traces, request bodies, or private execution data on the card. Prefer a restricted n8n execution link.

patterns.title: Infrastructure alert
patterns.summary: A monitored resource crossed a configured threshold.
patterns.create: An existing monitor or scheduled workflow creates an alert when its own threshold rule fires.
patterns.update: Update the same caller-correlated card when the workflow observes recovery; persist threshold and transition policy in n8n.
patterns.callback: No callback required. A request-button may open a deterministic acknowledge route only after the workflow validates actor and target.
patterns.sensitivity: Expose only operational summaries and approved resource labels. Exclude hostnames, addresses, logs, and topology when they are sensitive.

patterns.title: Service status
patterns.summary: Current service state and a short operational detail.
patterns.create: Create a status card when monitoring begins or when an operator needs a persistent view.
patterns.update: Update the same outTrackId on observed state changes; choose allowed states idle, running, success, failed, cancelled.
patterns.callback: No callback required. Any request-button callback remains asynchronous and must route through deterministic workflow validation.
patterns.sensitivity: Keep details concise and avoid customer data, internal endpoints, or unredacted diagnostic output.

patterns.title: Task progress
patterns.create: Create once when the task starts, using a caller-controlled stable outTrackId.
patterns.update: Update that card with concise progress and a terminal status when known. Workflow persists progress and decides update cadence.
patterns.callback: No callback required. Do not imply that the node stores task state or enforces transitions.
patterns.sensitivity: Do not expose job payloads, personal data, or secrets in progress text.

patterns.title: Daily digest
patterns.summary: A concise roll-up of the period.
patterns.create: A schedule or existing workflow aggregates already available data and creates one digest.
patterns.update: Create a new dated digest per period, or update a known current-period card; workflow chooses and persists that policy.
patterns.sensitivity: Aggregate or redact personal and confidential source data before constructing items.

patterns.title: Technical digest
patterns.summary: A short engineering update assembled upstream.
patterns.create: An existing schedule or workflow creates the digest from data supplied to it.
patterns.update: Prefer a new dated card per digest run; use Update only when intentionally revising the same run.
patterns.sensitivity: Remove unreleased details, private repository names, tokens, and internal incident data unless the audience is authorized.

patterns.title: Repository report
patterns.summary: Summary of repository changes; source data is supplied upstream.
patterns.sourceShape: GitHub: title, summary, sections, optional approved detail URL
patterns.create: An existing workflow supplies prepared GitHub-shaped data and creates a report card.
patterns.update: Create a new report for each reporting window or update the same known report; workflow owns that choice.
patterns.callback: No callback required; no GitHub ingestion or API integration is included.
patterns.sensitivity: Check repository visibility and redact private project or contributor information for the card audience.

patterns.title: Feed report
patterns.summary: Summary of selected feed entries; source data is supplied upstream.
patterns.sourceShape: RSS: title, summary, sections, optional approved detail URL
patterns.create: An existing workflow supplies selected and sanitized feed entries and creates a report card.
patterns.update: Use a new card per reporting window or update a known current report according to workflow policy.
patterns.callback: No callback required; no feed polling or ingestion is included.
patterns.sensitivity: Treat feed text as untrusted content; summarize safely and avoid rendering it as HTML or template code.

patterns.title: Changelog report
patterns.summary: A concise release summary; source data is supplied upstream.
patterns.sourceShape: Changelog: title, summary, sections, optional approved detail URL
patterns.create: An existing workflow supplies prepared changelog data and creates a report card.
patterns.update: Create one card per release/reporting window; update only to correct that same report.
patterns.callback: No callback required; no changelog discovery or ingestion is included.
patterns.sensitivity: Publish only release information approved for the card audience.

patterns.title: Detailed report available
patterns.create: Create a concise report card and bind detailUrl as a user-owned extra template variable using the existing Form parameter map or whole-body JSON input.
patterns.update: Update summary and detailUrl together when revising the same report; the workflow owns URL access policy.
patterns.callback: A detail link is navigation, not a callback action. Any separate request-button requires Stream callbacks and verified action handling.
patterns.sensitivity: Use an access-controlled URL for restricted reports; do not assume DingTalk card visibility grants report access.
